The GateRook field guide

Your stack.
Connected to AI.

From the first connection to a useful answer. Find your service, follow the setup, and see exactly what your AI can do through MCP.

Start with GateRookExplore 15 integration guides

One workflow for your whole stack

Connect. Set boundaries. Ask.

01 · Add a connection

Choose a connector, enter its configuration in GateRook, and test that your computer can reach the service.

02 · Create an endpoint

Select connections and give each tool a mode: Off, Read only, or Approval. Keep development and production separate.

03 · Connect your AI

Use Clients to connect your MCP app. The agent requests tools; GateRook checks access, runs allowed calls and returns results.

Find your integration

A practical guide for every connection.

Built-in connectors, supported database variants, log backends and external MCP servers. Each guide includes configuration, available tools, an illustrated request and troubleshooting.
